_doc: Icons (v0.8.4.43), read only by IconRules.of. An icon is a file assets/icons/<kind>/<id>.png; `shared` gives one file to several ids, `source` says where a file came from. With no file: an item takes its plain base's icon (ItemRules.plain_of) with the marks below, else its group's; a spell is the blank of its kind in its school's colour with marks of its damage and shape; anything else the blank of its kind, then _blank/default.png. Marks and colours are drawn by the interface, no picture is needed for them; a file assets/icons/marks/<what>/<id>.png replaces a mark's dot.

shared._doc: "<kind>/<id>": "<kind>/<id>" — the second's file stands for the first.

source._doc: "<kind>/<id>": where its file came from — forge (tools/anima), hand, or a licence line (CC BY …).

ui._doc: Icons of the interface itself: window buttons, needs, acts of a place. The id is the file ui/<id>.png, the value its subject for the artist.
ui.sheet: character sheet: a scroll with a portrait
ui.deeds: a bundle of tools: hammer, quill and coin
ui.weapon_set: two crossed swords with an arrow

rarity._doc: The frame of an item by its rarity; none for a common thing.

schools._doc: The tint of a spell's icon with no file of its own, by `school_id`.

elements._doc: A mark of a damage type: on an item by its property <type>_damage, on a spell by `damage_type`.

materials._doc: A mark of a material: by an item's property, its `material` or the start of its id (adamantine_…).

shapes._doc: A mark of a spell's area by `area.type`.
